mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_knowledge_document (title, file_id, file_name, file_path, source_type, status, chunk_count, error_message, created_by) VALUES (#{title}, #{fileId}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{sourceType}, #{status}, #{chunkCount}, #{errorMessage}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, file_id, file_name, file_path, source_type, status, chunk_count, error_message, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM ai_knowledge_document WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, title, file_id, file_name, file_path, source_type, status, chunk_count, error_message, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM ai_knowledge_document WHERE id = #{id} AND created_by = #{userId}

SELECT id, title, file_id, file_name, file_path, source_type, status, chunk_count, error_message, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM ai_knowledge_document WHERE created_by = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai_knowledge_document WHERE id = #{id} AND created_by = #{userId}
